assumed_note: ASSUMED. The plan publishes a credit allowance and a charging multiplier; it publishes no per-request credit counter, so a run's credit consumption is DERIVED from its requests with the documented multiplier applied (S10.1 tier 3, S10.4 requests-as-proxy). Every number below is a dated row an operator may edit, never a platform constant, and the reading it produces is labeled assumed on every surface.
unit_note: The plan was denominated in PROMPTS when S10.4 was written and is denominated in CREDITS as of the verified-on date. Receipts and gauges say credits, because the unit changed and saying otherwise would be a quiet lie about what was counted.
weekly_reset_note: The weekly window starts counting from the time the order was placed and refreshes on a 7-day cycle, per account — it is not a calendar week. Verified 2026-08-23.

multipliers.name: peak
multipliers.note: The published peak window, in the provider's own timezone. Usage inside it is charged at the standard credit rate.

multipliers.name: off-peak
multipliers.note: Verbatim: model usage outside the peak window is charged at 50% of the standard credit rate. This is the DEFAULT row: every instant the peak window does not claim is off-peak.

quotas.name: rolling-5h
quotas.note: The GLM Coding Max rolling allowance.

quotas.name: weekly
quotas.note: The GLM Coding Max weekly allowance. Its window is order-anchored per account (see weekly_reset), so this length is the cycle, not a calendar week.
